title: Delivery, Storage and Finished-Piece Inclusions by Programme
content:
# Delivery, Storage and Finished-Piece Inclusions by Programme

The programme terms of Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions for the finished piece: how it is handed over, whether a member of staff delivers it in person, how many calendar days it is held after completion before storage is charged, the storage charged per started month after that period, whether an appraisal is prepared within the quoted total and on what basis it values the piece, whether an independent laboratory certificate is obtained for the centre stone, whether the piece is professionally photographed, how many engraved characters are included, and whether the upgraded presentation box is included.

## Terms

| Programme | Delivery method | Delivered in person by staff | Held without charge after completion (calendar days) | Storage per started month thereafter | Appraisal included | Appraisal basis | Laboratory certificate for the centre stone | Professional photography | Engraved characters included | Upgraded presentation box |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | collection from the store | no | 30 | USD 20.00 | no | retail replacement value | no | no | 0 | no |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | collection from the store | no | 30 | USD 20.00 | no | retail replacement value | no | yes | 12 | no |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | collection from the store | no | 45 | USD 35.00 | yes | retail replacement value | yes | yes | 20 | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | private appointment | yes | 60 | USD 60.00 | yes | retail replacement value | yes | yes | 30 | yes |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | collection from the store | no | 45 | USD 35.00 | yes | fair market value | no | yes | 20 | yes |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | private appointment | yes | 90 | USD 125.00 | yes | retail replacement value | yes | yes | 60 | yes |

## Questions answered from the terms

**Which programmes hand the piece over by private appointment?** The Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission, both delivered in person by a member of staff; every other programme is collected from the store.

**On what basis does an included appraisal value the piece?** On retail replacement value under every programme that includes one, except the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission, whose included appraisal is on fair market value.

**What does a finished Design Studio Custom Setting piece cost to leave uncollected?** Nothing for 30 calendar days after completion, then USD 20.00 for each started month it stays; a piece collected on the 31st day has begun one started month and carries one month's charge.
